title: gRoMA: a Tool for Measuring the Global Robustness of Deep Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring the robustness of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to adversarial inputs, which is crucial for their safe and reliable deployment in safety-critical systems. While safety and reliability are ethical concerns in application, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics themselves, but rather a technical aspect (robustness) that contributes to ethical deployment.
